_reader: Claude (Opus 5.5), the architecture role that wrote the pipeline, the frozen checks and the repaired checks; after unblinding round 3, 13 Nov 2026. Not an independent or human reader.
_method: As in round 2 (data/fault_trial/round2/ADJUDICATION_READER.json), against round 3's per-run rerun (results/ft_perrun_r3/) and the repaired configuration's per-run firings (results/fault_trial_r3.json, per_run). The episodes a fault exercises are those the manifest lists for it. Localization refers to the repaired configuration: cause = a firing check tests the mechanism the patch broke, on an episode the fault exercises; other_run = repaired checks fired only on other runs; diffuse = several checks across layers, the mechanism's among them; missed = no repaired check fired (frozen instrument; see DEVIATIONS.md for fault 05).
